title: Let a worker cap its own cell from inside its granted worktree
action: cells finish is refused inside a granted worktree by emit_unsupported_root (verbs/mod.rs:114-138), because cells verbs use the NARROW door resolve_store_root (roots.rs:610-631). The refusal is policy, not physics: worktree, status/orient and reservations already read and write the main store from inside a worktree through the FULL door and StoreRoots::hold_topology (roots.rs:541-551). Port cells finish onto that road, per the logged decision: the cell record and its claim resolve at the MAIN store, the declared tests run with cwd in the WORKTREE, and the holds release uses hold_topology's (main_root, git-verified worktree id) pair instead of finish_support.rs holds_ledger_path(root) and CROSS_WORKTREE_HOLDS_LOCK keyed at the resolved root - the un-ported piece roots.rs:91-100 names as the reason cells stayed narrow. Keep every other cells verb refused as it is today. The D6 commit-trailer check already scans the worktree branch (finish_support.rs:226-235) and must keep doing so.

truths: cells finish from a granted worktree caps the cell in the main store
the declared tests run against the worktree tree, not main
reservation and hold release names the worktree id as holder and actually releases
running finish from main is byte-identical to today
other cells verbs still refuse from a worktree
